[[Image:Tremalking map.png|thumb|right|200px|Location]]
'''Tremalking''' is a large and highly mountainous island found southwest of the main landmass of the [[Westlands]].{{ref/book|8|1}} It is the largest of the [[Sea Folk]] islands.{{ref/book|10|21}} The female statue of the [[Choedan Kal]] stands on the island. It is populated by the peaceful [[Amayar]].

[[File:Female Choedan Kal.jpg|thumb|200px|left|''Choedan Kal'' on '''Tremalking'''.]]

== History ==
The peaceful Amayar lived on Tremalking for centuries, and manufactured precious porcelain. They were governed by the ''[[Atha'an Miere]]'', and had a friendly relationship, though did not interact much on a personal basis.

During the [[Cleansing of saidin|cleansing of ''saidin'']], the Amayar observed the hand of the female Choedan Kal glowing as [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] used the access key in [[Shadar Logoth]]. The Amayar interpreted this as the end of the [[Time of Illusion]], and committed mass suicide.{{ref/book|9|35}}

== Trivia ==
* There is a tavern in [[Tar Valon]] called [[The Tremalking Splice]].{{ref/book|3|30}}
* There is a tea known as Tremalking black.{{ref/book|3|40}}
